gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Blink's own Solaris FAQ and setup guide, read 2026-11-17, name the Outdoor 2K+ as the only compatible camera and never mention the Outdoor 4. Blink's Amazon listing title also says 'Only compatible with Outdoor 2K+ camera'. That leaves a cable-connected USB-C panel as the only solar option for an Outdoor 4, and Blink does not support third-party power: its page says 'We cannot warranty devices connected to unreliable power sources'.
standout_why: Compared against the two pages ChatGPT cited (Blink Solaris FAQ en_US and Solar Panel Mount FAQ) and the top uncited results (How to Power your Blink Camera, Outdoor 4 Battery Extension Pack install). ChatGPT told the shopper Solaris 'works with Outdoor 4' and cited the Solaris FAQ for it. Today that FAQ, its en_GB and helpjuice copies, and the setup guide name only the Outdoor 2K+. None of the ChatGPT results joins this to Blink's stated non-support of third-party power or to the Extension Pack blocking the Outdoor 4's USB-C socket.
decides: This reverses ChatGPT's pick. Blink no longer lists Solaris for the Outdoor 4 on its own pages or its Amazon title, and only retailer titles (Best Buy) still pair them. An Outdoor 4 owner should not buy Solaris unless Blink lists it again. The working choice is a separately mounted panel that plugs into the camera's USB-C socket, such as the Wasserstein panel at $36.99. Blink won't warranty or support that setup, and it can't be combined with the Outdoor 4 Battery Extension Pack. Our page's Solaris row ('Yes: Outdoor 4 and Outdoor 2K+') must change.

findings.label: Compatible cameras (maker FAQ)
findings.value: Outdoor 2K+ only: 'Blink Solaris is compatible with the Blink Outdoor 2K+.' The Outdoor 4 is not named anywhere on the page.
findings.note: This is the page ChatGPT cited for 'works with Outdoor 4'. I asked specifically whether 'Outdoor 4' or '4th Gen' appears, and neither does. Also on the page: the AA-removal step names only the Outdoor 2K+, 'It cannot be mounted separate from camera', and the Outdoor Floodlight Mount is not compatible with Solaris.

findings.value: Outdoor 2K+ only, in each of three copies

Search-engine summaries claimed an Outdoor 4 line, including that Solaris charging status doesn't show in the app on an Outdoor 4, but no page I opened has that line.

findings.note: No firmware or app-version requirement is stated, and the Outdoor 4 is not mentioned.

findings.label: Blink stance on third-party power (applies to Wasserstein and generic panels)
findings.value: 'Third party power solutions are not supported because of the various problems and safety issues that may arise.' 'We cannot warranty devices connected to unreliable power sources, or when weather protection is removed.'
findings.source_title: How to Power your Blink Camera — Blink Support
findings.note: This page is in ChatGPT's results but was not cited. It says the Weather Resistant Power Adapter 'can be used for the Outdoor 4 and Outdoor (3rd Gen) cameras' and 'The Blink Solar Panel Mount is only compatible with the Outdoor (3rd Gen).' Solaris is not mentioned. Its generic line on rear USB ports says 'micro USB cable', which conflicts with the Extension Pack page's 'USB-C power socket' for the Outdoor 4.

findings.label: Conflict with any cable-fed solar panel
findings.value: When the pack is fitted, 'the Outdoor 4's USB-C power socket is blocked'. The pack holds 4 AA lithium cells and fits only the Outdoor 4 and Outdoor 2K+.
findings.source_title: Installing Outdoor 4 Battery Extension Pack — Blink Support
findings.note: So a USB-C solar panel and the Extension Pack can't be used together on an Outdoor 4. The page states 'This product is only compatible with the Blink Outdoor 4 and Outdoor 2K+ cameras.'
